subject: general
question: As per the Hurun India rich list 2024, who replaced Reliance Industries chairman Mukesh Ambani?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gautam Adani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gautam Adani**, the chairman of the Adani Group, has surpassed Mukesh Ambani in the Hurun India Rich List 2024.
 
• The Adani Group is a diversified conglomerate with interests in ports, energy, and logistics, among other sectors.
 
• Gautam Adani's net worth saw a significant increase, primarily driven by the performance of Adani Group companies in the stock market.
 
• This marks a significant shift in the rankings of India's wealthiest individuals, with Adani Group's rapid expansion contributing to Gautam Adani's rise.
 
• Gautam Adani's net worth is now estimated to be significantly higher than Mukesh Ambani's, reflecting the changing dynamics of wealth accumulation in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adani Group**

 
 
• The Adani Group, founded by Gautam Adani in 1988, is one of India's largest business conglomerates.
 
• It operates in various sectors including energy, resources, logistics, agribusiness, real estate, financial services, and defense.
 
• The group is known for its significant investments in infrastructure and development projects across India and abroad.
 
 
 
• **Hurun India Rich List**
 
 
• The Hurun India Rich List is an annual ranking of the wealthiest individuals in India.
 
• It is compiled by the Hurun Report, a leading research and luxury publishing group based in Shanghai.
 
• The list provides insights into the wealth and financial status of India's richest individuals and families.
 
 
 
• **Mukesh Ambani**
 
 
• Mukesh Ambani is the chairman and largest shareholder of Reliance Industries, one of India's largest conglomerates.
 
• He has consistently been one of the richest individuals in India and the world, largely due to the success of Reliance Industries.
 
• Reliance Industries operates in sectors such as petrochemicals, refining, oil, telecommunications, and retail.
